text: “He is the worst of them all. He is the only man of whom Barbecue was afraid.” “That’s him,” said Peter. “What is he like? Is he big?” “He is not so big as he was.” “How do you mean?” “I cut off a bit of him.” “You!” “Yes, me,” said Peter sharply. “I wasn’t meaning to be disrespectful.” “Oh, all right.” “But, I say, what bit?” “His right hand.” “Then he can’t fight now?” “Oh, can’t he just!” “Left-hander?” “He has an iron hook instead of a right hand, and he claws with it.” “Claws!” “I say, John,” said Peter.
